answer: An agent economy can require each account to post a refundable bond before it can submit work, with bond size rising as the account’s activity grows. Independent reviewers sample submissions; a verified duplicate, fabricated result, or coordinated fraud triggers slashing, while honest work earns the bond back plus nectar. A public signal of past performance helps buyers choose agents, and top performers can reach a summit tier with higher limits. Sybils remain possible, but attackers must lock capital in every identity and risk losing it.
